aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Mother Siddhidātrī; you are the giver of siddhi.
You are the protector of devotees, the mother of your servants.
The moment one takes your name, siddhi is gained;
through your name the mind is made pure.
aarti.pad2: whenever you place your hand on your servant's head.
In your worship there is no set rite;
Jagadambā, you are the giver, you are every siddhi.
aarti.pad3: whoever holds your image alone in his mind:
you bring all his work to completion,
and his tasks never remain unfinished.
aarti.pad4: Your mercy and this māyā of yours:
he over whose head the Mother keeps her shade,
O giver of all siddhis, is fortunate,
he who asks at your door alone, Ambā.
aarti.pad5: Himācala is the mountain where you dwell;
you dwell in the Mahā Nandā temple.
Mother, your support alone is mine;
devotion is the one who asks, and you are its giver.
